In the Kagoshima Prefecture, expert farmers cultivate matcha with patience and precision. Shading the leaves before harvest intensifies chlorophyll and sweetness, while careful deveining and slow stone-grinding preserve purity and flavour. The result is a vibrant green powder that reflects its origin — clean, balanced, and alive with energy. Whether whisked traditionally or infused into food and drink, Hikari Reserve embodies Japanese craftsmanship at its finest. “Bright, clean, and quietly powerful.
